entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The buildings look like specks[n]from here. This truly is the best[n]altitude at which to test.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The atmospheric pressure should[n]have dropped at this height.[n]Are your ears okay?
They feel weird.
My heart is pounding.[clr 27]
I'm completely fine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Can you pop them?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Try pinching your nose and [n]breathing out. Yawning can do[n]the trick sometimes as well.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Are you afraid of heights?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hm, you don't look like[n]the type who is... Could it[n]be due to something else?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, I hope this doesn't[n]affect the results.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That's reassuring, but it could[n]prove to be troublesome.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It might negate the effects of[n]experimenting at this altitude. I[n]hope it doesn't ruin my results.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Well, we'll just have [n]to give it a try.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I really hope this data helps[n]me complete the development[n]of the medicine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Clinical trials like this usually[n]can't be performed, after all.[n]You really are a useful guy.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I have to thank you for that,[n]my little guinea pig.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Okay, clothes off.[n]Let's get started.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Relax. Kidding.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Give me your hand.[n]First, we'll take your pulse,[n]and then...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: We got some great data today.[n]Thanks.
